verify.title: Student verification
verify.intro: Type the No. CI from your card and upload a photo of the front of your Carné de Identidad. Verification is automatic and instant.
verify.cardNote: The photo must show the full front of the Carné de Identidad: the card title, the No. CI, your photo and your names. Photos showing only the number are not accepted.
verify.ciLabel: No. CI (11 digits, on your card)
verify.ciHint: The first 6 digits must match your date of birth (YYMMDD).
verify.pending: Your ID has already been submitted and is under review.
verify.errorType: The file must be an image (JPG or PNG).
verify.errorNoDob: Your date of birth is missing. Please add it in your registration.
verify.errorCiFormat: The No. CI must be exactly 11 digits.

results.approved: Verified! You can now post ads.
results.ciMismatch: The No. CI doesn't match your date of birth. Check the number or your date of birth.

admin.title: Admin panel

admin.confirmCi: The handwritten No. CI matches the number the student typed.
